color.note: Monotone Slate. One soft blue-grey carries the brand; colour comes from the garments in photography, not from graphics.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page, canvas and print ground.

tokens.name: surface-bone
tokens.usage: Warm alternate panel, product backdrops and photo placeholders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Logo, headlines and body text on surface and surface-bone (7.6:1 or more in both themes). Also the fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, captions and secondary text on surface and surface-bone (4.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: primary buttons and inverted panels. Never use literal white on ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline rules between sections. Decorative only, never the sole cue.

tokens.name: slate-deep
tokens.usage: Deep panels, dark photo placeholders and the ground for gold foil. White text on it reads at 11.7:1.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Tone-on-tone thread on black fabric only. Never text.

tokens.name: gold-foil
tokens.usage: Physical foil stamping only (boxes, hang tags, gift cards), on slate-deep stock. Never on-screen text.

tokens.name: fabric-slate
tokens.usage: Colour swatch chip for the Slate colourway. Product colour, never brand graphics.

tokens.name: fabric-ceil
tokens.usage: Colour swatch chip for the Ceil Blue colourway. Product colour, never brand graphics.

tokens.name: fabric-black
tokens.usage: Colour swatch chip for the Black colourway. Product colour, never brand graphics.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Jost carries the whole brand. Uppercase is always tracked; sentence case never is.

styles.name: display-caps
styles.usage: Campaign headlines and covers. Uppercase, five words or fewer, same weight and tracking as the wordmark. Scale up on large canvases (76px on a 1080px post).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Sentence-case headlines longer than five words: web heroes, product pages, stories.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Premium scrubs with a clean V-neck and pockets where your hands go.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and product descriptions, in ink or ink-muted.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Slate · Regular fit · Sizes XS to 3XL
styles.usage: Product details, captions, legal and hang-tag copy.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Labels above headlines, navigation and the tagline. Always uppercase, in ink-muted or ink.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and call-to-action links. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Accent
groups.note: One accent per layout, at most.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: One emphasised word or a short pull quote beside display-caps. Lowercase or sentence case; never body copy, never uppercase.

spacing.note: 8px base. Generous margins are the premium signal.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, swatch gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to headline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs; card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Headline to body; button padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer margin on screens and 1080px social canvases (80px on 1080×1350 posts).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Outer margin on print, posters and web heroes.

radius.note: Square-cornered. Softness comes from space and colour, not radii.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for photos, panels, cards and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and tags.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Colour swatch chips and size selectors only.

logo.note: Clear space and minimum sizes for every lockup.

tokens.name: logo-clearspace
tokens.usage: Clear space on all sides = one cross arm, about a third of the icon's width.

tokens.name: logo-min-stacked
tokens.usage: Smallest stacked lockup on screen (25mm in print).

tokens.name: logo-min-horizontal
tokens.usage: Smallest horizontal lockup on screen (35mm in print). Below this, use the chest mark.

tokens.name: logo-min-icon
tokens.usage: Smallest icon on screen (6mm in print).

tokens.name: chest-mark-width
tokens.usage: Left-chest embroidery width, 75 to 90mm. Thread: white on dark fabric, slate on light fabric, graphite tone-on-tone on black.
